rounds.text: The market is currently pricing PS IT Infrastructure & Services Ltd at a deep discount, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.21x [E1]. This recent performance outpaces the sector median sales growth of 16.6%, indicating that the business is successfully capturing momentum [E59]. Conceded: [E3, E4, E5, E7, E8, E53]. The current market capitalization of ₹ 6.79 Cr reflects a disconnect between the company's recent growth trajectory and its depressed valuation [E2, E15].
